title: Stunning Lake House on Old Hickory Lake
description:
Stunning Lake House with 180 degree Panoramic views of Old Hickory Lake in Gallatin, TN. There is a temporary dock (you can tie boat and launch directly next property). Outside hot tub. 3 bedroom (2 Master’s) 3.5 bath and bonus room.
Master: King
Master #2: Queen
Bedroom #3: Queen
Bonus Room: (2) Twins
2 living rooms. 
Large covered Outdoor Living space with Natural gas Grill and Bar height Fire table.
2 indoor fireplaces
25 mins to downtown airport

The space
You will have access to entire house, boat dock (temporary dock , not in the best condition, but it is available) If you are bringing a boat, please notify me. Public boat ramp and  park next door (dawn to dusk) Room for RV parking

Guest access
You have access to the entire home, boat dock (temporary dock is at property- dock was lost in Tornado and waiting on new dock) on property.

Other things to note
There is a public park and boat ramp next to the house with playground.
